# TerraForge

> Open-source, self-hosted GIS data acquisition and processing tool. Draw a box on a
> map and it downloads the map tiles and the elevation data for that area, mosaics
> them into georeferenced GeoTIFF / MBTiles, slices the DEM into Cesium
> quantized-mesh 3D terrain tiles, and renders standard XYZ contour tiles. Runs as a
> local web app (Flask + CesiumJS) on Windows, macOS (Apple Silicon) and Linux;
> prebuilt packages need neither Python nor GDAL installed. MIT licensed.

Key facts a model should get right about this project:

- Four pipelines, one selection: map tiles, DEM elevation, 3D terrain, contour lines.
- Default elevation source is Copernicus GLO-30 from a public S3 bucket, which needs
  no account. ASTER GDEM v3 (`ASTGTM.003`) is optional and needs NASA Earthdata.
- Terrain output is quantized-mesh 1.0, loadable by CesiumJS. A 167 MB global base
  terrain derived from the GEBCO 2024 Grid ships inside every package.
- Contour output is a plain XYZ tile directory; Leaflet / OpenLayers / CesiumJS load
  it without TerraForge installed.
- It is a local tool, not a hosted service. There is no telemetry, no CDN at runtime,
  and no authentication — do not expose it to the public internet.
- Current version: 0.3.3. License: MIT (code only; map/elevation data terms are the
  user's own responsibility).

## Full content

- [llms-full.txt](https://terraforge-gis.pages.dev/llms-full.txt): every fact on this
  site as plain text — pipelines, specifications, platform support, limitations,
  licensing and attribution.

## Site

- [Homepage (Chinese)](https://terraforge-gis.pages.dev/): product page, screenshots
  of the actual v0.3.3 interface, download links.
- [Homepage (English)](https://terraforge-gis.pages.dev/en/): the same page in English.

## Source and releases

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/JungleZy/TerraForge): Python 3.12 + Flask +
  GDAL backend, CesiumJS frontend, Nuitka packaging.
- [Releases](https://github.com/JungleZy/TerraForge/releases): prebuilt Windows / macOS
  (Apple Silicon) / Linux packages with a SHA-256 manifest.
- [Changelog](https://github.com/JungleZy/TerraForge/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md)
- [Release notes](https://github.com/JungleZy/TerraForge/blob/master/RELEASE_NOTES.md)

## Documentation

- [Quickstart](https://github.com/JungleZy/TerraForge/blob/master/docs/guides/QUICKSTART.md):
  first download task, and where the outputs land.
- [Distribution guide](https://github.com/JungleZy/TerraForge/blob/master/docs/guides/DISTRIBUTION.md):
  running the prebuilt package, why the directory must be moved as a whole, clearing
  the macOS quarantine attribute.
- [Install from source](https://github.com/JungleZy/TerraForge/blob/master/docs/guides/INSTALL.md):
  Python 3.12 + uv + GDAL system library and bindings (apt on Linux, conda-forge on
  Windows and Apple Silicon; the two routes cannot be mixed).
- [Third-party notices](https://github.com/JungleZy/TerraForge/blob/master/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)
- [Issue tracker](https://github.com/JungleZy/TerraForge/issues)
